scenes.label: the biggest number a signed 32 bit integer holds
scenes.narration: Many systems count seconds since nineteen seventy in a signed thirty two bit integer. The biggest number it holds is {u_max_say}.
That many seconds after nineteen seventy is {u_date}, at {u_time}. One second later, the counter overflows.
It wraps around to a negative number, which reads as nineteen oh one. The fix is sixty four bit time, and most modern systems already use it.
